title: The A to Z default is its own saved value: restoring a state with no financial sort returns to A to Z, not an arbitrary column
custom_preconds: 1. You have never clicked a financial column header in this browser session/profile (the report is in the A→Z default).
custom_steps:
1. Change a few filters (no sort click), leave the report, and return.
2. Read the row order and the headers.
custom_expected:
1. The report restores to the A→Z default order by rep display name.
2. No financial column shows a sort indicator — the saved "no financial sort" state restores as A→Z, not as an arbitrary column.
